close_reason:
Wired enforce_max_objects_in_set into handle_metadata_set immediately after the account_exists gate, mirroring the canonical mail-server pattern (bd:JMAP-ayoz.41.2) exactly:

- src/helpers.rs: pub(crate) use jmap_server::{enforce_max_objects_in_set, extract_account_id}
- src/metadata.rs: imported enforce_max_objects_in_set; called as
    enforce_max_objects_in_set(&args, backend.max_objects_in_set(caller, &account_id))?;
  placed between account_exists and get_state per the canonical position.

Tests in tests/max_objects_in_set.rs (3 new tests):
- metadata_set_over_limit_create_returns_limit_error (501 creates → JmapError type=limit description=maxObjectsInSet)
- metadata_set_over_limit_destroy_returns_limit_error (501 destroys → same)
- metadata_set_at_limit_passes_cap_check (exactly DEFAULT_CAP creates pass the cap)

Hand-built independent oracle (error_type, description string pair) per workspace test-integrity rules — the helper under test is never the oracle.

Pre-commit gate: cargo fmt clean, cargo clippy --workspace --all-features -D warnings clean, cargo test -p jmap-metadata-server clean (50+3+3+27+1 tests pass), workspace cargo test clean. Pre-existing rustdoc broken-intra-doc-link at lib.rs:50 surfaced and filed separately (counterpart of bd:JMAP-ha4n) — not introduced by this change (verified via git stash before/after).

Closing this bead completes the metadata-server arm of the .41 sweep (the original direct target of the analysis bead). Committed in 32b9b00.
